from wordcount import count_words


def test_count_words_skips_comment_lines():
    assert count_words('# note\nhello world\n') == 2


def test_indented_comment_line_is_skipped():
    assert count_words('  \t# note here\nhello\n') == 1


def test_hash_after_first_word_is_not_a_comment():
    assert count_words('hello # world\n') == 3


def test_comment_only_and_empty_input_count_zero():
    assert count_words('# a b c') == 0
    assert count_words('') == 0


def test_words_separated_by_any_whitespace_run():
    assert count_words('a  b\t\tc \n\n d') == 4
EOF

cat > wordcount.py <<'EOF'
def count_words(text: str) -> int:
    """Count whitespace-separated words, ignoring comment lines."""
    total = 0
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.lstrip().startswith('#'):
            continue
        total += len(line.split())
    return total
EOF
